name: Proxima Centauri
source: Kervella, Thevenin & Lovis (2017), A&A 598 L7, Table 2
note: Historical published input set, not a claim of latest Gaia astrometry. Radial velocity is the paper's gravitational-redshift-corrected value. The paper neglects the epoch difference between astrometry and RV; this teaching model adopts the same simplification. No covariance or binary orbit is propagated.
